setting.camera_utils.zoom_initial.toolti: The zoom level when you first press the keybind.
setting.camera_utils.zoom_scroll_enabled: Allow mouse wheel scrolling to adjust zoom level
setting.camera_utils.zoom_scroll_step_co: How many scroll steps in each direction. You can scroll to zoom in or out from the initial zoom.
setting.camera_utils.zoom_per_step.toolt: The zoom multiplier applied per scroll step. 1.5x means each step zooms in 50% more.
setting.camera_utils.zoom_remember_steps: Keep scroll zoom amount between zooming in and out.
setting.camera_utils.zoom_key_behavior.t: Hold key to zoom, or press key to toggle zoom on/off
setting.camera_utils.zoom_relative_sensi: Mouse sensitivity percentage relative to zoom level (0% to 150%)
setting.camera_utils.freecam_speed.toolt: Flight speed of the detached freecam
setting.camera_utils.freeze_player.toolt: Prevent player body movements while in freecam
setting.camera_utils.toggle_mode.tooltip: Toggle Freelock on/off instead of holding key
setting.camera_utils.return_speed.toolti: Speed of camera transition back to original angle
